name: American Legion Auxiliary Empire Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of New York
city: New York State (check-in at SUNY Brockport)
what_you_do: Spend a week as a citizen of a pretend 51st state. You run campaigns, write and debate bills and fill county and state offices.
who_can_apply: Girls. Your local American Legion Auxiliary unit picks citizens and alternates, sometimes with interviews, essays or a nomination. The pages read did not list a grade or residency rule, so ask your unit.
pay_detail: A non-refundable application fee is required. The amount is not stated on the pages read. Optional extras (shirts, survival kit) have order forms.
duration: One week: Sunday June 27 to Friday July 2, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 session: Sunday June 27 to Friday July 2, 2027 (from the site's save-the-date notice). No 2027 application deadline or registration opening is posted.
how_to_apply: Contact your local American Legion Auxiliary unit. Ask your guidance counselor or email egsregistrar@gmail.com with your hometown, county and school. Join the local selection. Then use the login the unit gives you. Register online and pay the fee.
notes: Girls only. The site says there is a virtual orientation on Zoom in May or June. The program says it is not a sports camp or a recreational camp.
